title: Oak Valley Community Bank Announces Commercial Banking Officer Hiring
summary: OAKDALE, Calif., May 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Oak Valley Community Bank, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Oak Valley Bancorp (NASDAQ: OVLY), is pleased to announce the addition of Katie Alves as Vice President, Commercial Banking Officer. She will be based at the Bank’s Lodi Branch at 31 South School Street. With more than 20 years of banking experience, Alves joins Oak Valley with a strong background in relationship management, most recently serving as a Relationship Manager at another local financial institution.
